It is lightweight and easy to wear, transitioning perfectly from your morning coffee to a night out with friends.

✨ WHY YOU'LL LOVE IT
♡ Delicate moon motif with a clean, polished finish

♡ Versatile gold tone that matches your favorite jewelry
♡ Easy to wear design that fits most standard nostril piercings

PRODUCT DETAILS
• Material: Gold-plated stainless steel
• Gauge: 20G standard size

• Style: Nostril or ear piercing

💝 A MEANINGFUL GIFT

✨ WHY YOU'LL LOVE IT
♡ Deep magnetic cat eye finish that shifts beautifully in the light
